empty: No prepared content is available for this service.
webScope: Uses the same presentation component as the public directory. Private preview of the text and selected, eligible website media; visibility and delivery remain separate decisions.
unavailable: Some media could not be verified or displayed. Check the media library before deciding.
noPhoto: No selected, eligible website photo is available in the current data.
socialScope: Indicative preview of the text and its destination. Verify the final rendering, media and publishing authorization in the publication workflow.
preparationScope: Resources assigned to this service in the dossier’s library. This private preview grants no usage right, editorial approval or publication authorization.
noAssignment: No media is assigned to this service yet. Additions, corrections and assignments are managed in the dossier’s library.
noSocialPhoto: No assigned photo eligible for this destination is available for this preview.
assignmentStale: Outdated assignment: check the media and service versions in the library.
assignmentReview: Assignment prepared; media checks still need to be completed.
assignmentCurrent: Current assignment; publication remains a separate decision.
libraryScope: All media in this dossier can be consulted here in read-only mode. Assignments to this service are identified separately; unassigned files are not added to the rendering. Additions, corrections and assignments remain in the dossier’s library.
librarySearch: Search a filename, alternative text or file type
libraryEmpty: This dossier’s media library contains no media.
missingAssignments: Some assignments to this service reference media that are no longer available in the current library.
